findings.rationale: A real contradiction left over from the G1 fold: P2 still carries the old 'cached in the per-agent state file on the first call' sentence. Bounded repair: delete that sentence. 'No cache, re-derive every call' is the rule.
Same defect as 03034fdf, closed by the same deletion. Because the role is re-derived every call, a transient first-read failure can no longer stick.
Duplicate of 03034fdf (a role-caching self-contradiction), closed by the same bounded repair.

A real G1-fold leftover: P3 still contains the old short entry text. Bounded repair: delete it, so the single fixed directive (which names every allowed verb) is the only reserve text, used for entry and for every denial.

Folded: the matcher accepts absolute paths under /tmp/ or under the hook's own process.env.TMPDIR, and also the literal tokens $TMPDIR/ and ${TMPDIR}/ (expanded with the same value). The directive says 'under /tmp or your TMPDIR'.

Accepted as a named residual risk in §6. The guard is cost discipline against runaway loops, not a security boundary against a child that deliberately edits its own transcript file (a child with Bash could equally set the mode env or edit config). The 'cannot rewrite' wording is corrected to 'does not rewrite in normal operation'.

Decided in G1 (accepted_blocker 0ee6b400): the reserve applies to foremen by operator intent, and §2.5 and KR4 were reworded accordingly. The frozen rubric's R2 guards the cap VALUE and deny semantics, which are unchanged. The seat itself notes that depth-0 already decided this.
Folded: the AUTOPILOT_FOREMAN_GUARD_ROLE_CAPS env overlays the defaults per key. Keys it omits keep their defaults, foreman stays 40 unless named, and malformed pairs are ignored.

Role resolution only runs after the existing inert gate at hooks/foreman-guard.js main(): a payload without agent_id (depth-0) exits before any role code. The fallback can never cap depth-0, and a test pins this.

Folded: a segment matches an allowlist entry by its leading argv words (for example `git` then one of the listed subcommands; `kill` then only digit arguments). Further arguments are free, except for the rm/rmdir path rule.

Folded: in the deny-reason fallback, the reserve entry is announced only on the first NON-allowlisted reserve call (which is denied anyway), so it costs no extra call. mode=warn then keeps allowing and only writes the debug log, which is documented as not model-visible.
Folded: KR2's negative control now reads '8 denied attempts made AFTER the reserve opens exhaust it'.
Folded: the new suite gets an explicit inversion case in which a later transcript record contains `Role: worker` and the first record has none, so the result is foreman at 40.
